conviction_note: Near-zero. The print turns on one decision: whether Morito revises its FY plan (OrdP 3,700m) at Q3. At H1 it was already 58.4% of plan against a 5-year average of 50.5%, and the street (kabuyoho consensus OrdP 3,975m) is already above plan. This company held its plan at Q3 in 2024 and 2025, and both times the print was sold. It revised at Q3 in 2021 and 2023. A probability-weighted revision (about 45%, worth about +3 if it comes and about -1.8 if the plan is held) is worth roughly +0.3, offset by a small proxy negative on the Q3 comparison. The scaled number (p_up 49 x abs 2.8) leans a hair negative because this crowded-margin-long name (信用倍率 27.9) has sold its last two quarter-only prints. The two measurements disagree in sign by tenths, and both say 'no edge'.
bar: FY Nov-2026 consolidated ordinary profit consensus 3,975m yen (OP 3,775m, sales 65,400m), kabuyoho analyst consensus as of 2026-10-13 (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=9837), against the company plan of 3,700m held since 2026-01-14 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9837&b=k202607140010). The consensus is thin (one or two analysts; Iwai Cosmo rated A with a 2,200 target on 2026-04-17), so every size here is capped small. print_vs_bar_pct = my estimate of Q3 cumulative OrdP (~3,100m, i.e. Q3 OrdP ~950-1,000m against 933m a year earlier) against the ~3,000m that a consensus-paced year implies, an inference and not a sourced number.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register as of 2026-09-29: 0.0%, no position at or above 0.5%, no change (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 27.89x (baseline; kabutan quote page shows 27.89 on 2026-10-14, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9837), so leveraged retail is heavily long and there is no short fuel for a squeeze. No options and no skew. priced_lean_pct -0.875, mostly margin overhang (-0.72). Run-up +3.04% over 20 days, +0.55% over 5 days. Company buyback absorbing about 20,900 shares a month against roughly 50k shares of daily volume.

findings.finding: The forecast decision is the print. Morito held its FY plan at Q1 (OP progress 29.7%) and at H1 (OrdP 58.4% against a 5-year average of 50.5%, implying H2 OrdP -19.6% y/y). The street already sits above plan (consensus OrdP 3,975m vs 3,700m). On a normal Q3 (OrdP ~950-1,000m) cumulative progress reaches ~84-86%, the highest at any Q3 in its record (80.1% in FY2025). Its own Q3 revision record is mixed: revised in 2021 and 2023 (+10.2% OrdP on 2023-10-13), held in 2022, 2024 and 2025. The 2025 hold came at 80.1% progress and the stock fell ~2%. The FY ended 9.8% above plan with no profit revision, only a +1 yen dividend in November. Probability-weighted: ~45% a revision to around consensus (+3), ~55% a hold read as the usual conservatism (-1.8).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY2025 (2025-10-10 11:30, plan held at 80.1% progress): -1.96% to the close and -2.46% to the next close. Q1 FY2026 (2026-04-14 11:30, record quarter, plan held): -0.52% / -1.56%. H1 FY2026 (2026-07-14 13:00, plan held but DOE raise, progressive dividend, buyback and new MTP): +4.70% / +1.98%. Q3 FY2023 (2023-10-13 after the close, OrdP plan +10.2%): -3.5% the next session, on a weak market day. Prices from the Yahoo chart in the baseline sources.
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly unpriced. The stock trades at ~15x the company's own EPS (121 yen) and has gone nowhere since H1 (1,850 on 7/14, 1,824 now), so the price is not paying for a revision as a certainty. Had the market priced a revision in, the stock would have run up into the print; it did not (+0.55% over 5 days). Had it priced a hold, a margin-long book of 27.9x would already have been unwinding. What is not priced is which way the company goes this time, and its own record is split 2/3.
findings.independence: Consensus level from kabuyoho (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=9837). Plan-hold language from the H1 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260714592818.pdf, '現在のところ変更はございません'). 2023 Q3 revision from kabutan (https://s.kabutan.jp/stocks/9837/news/k202310130072/). These are separate documents, but all three bear on one decision and count once.

findings.finding: Q3 (Jun-Aug) is the first quarter this year with both acquisitions fully in the prior-year base: Ms.ID was consolidated from 2024-12-25 and Mitsuboshi from 2025-04-01 (per the H1 短信). It also laps a record-heat summer that drove 猛暑対策商品 and 空調服 materials: summer 2025 was +2.36C, ranked 1st, and summer 2026 was +1.02C, ranked 5th. Q3 growth is therefore likely low single digits after Q2's +7.3% OP. Q2 margin already slipped from 7.0% to 6.2%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name has sold quarter-only prints even when they beat: Q3 FY2025, with Q3 OrdP +29% y/y, fell ~2.5%; Q1 FY2026, with OP +68%, fell ~1.6%. The quarter itself has not been the line that moves it up.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The acquisition dates are in the public 短信 and the weather data is public, so anyone can compute the tougher comparison. It is filed small because no Japanese source on this name frames Q3 as the organic-comparison quarter. Kabutan's automatic headline will compare Q3 y/y against a strong 933m base.
findings.independence: Weather from nippon.com (https://www.nippon.com/ja/japan-data/h02891/): summer 2026 ranked 5th and 2025 ranked 1st. That is a macro proxy, and the transmission to the company is an inference.

findings.finding: No capital-return item is likely at this print. The DOE raise to 5.0% and progressive dividend explicitly apply from the FY Nov-2027 dividend. The buyback (up to 300k shares / ¥600m, 2026-07-16 to 2027-01-12) had bought only 50,000 shares / ¥90.5m by 9/30, at about 20,900 shares a month. Past returns news came at H1 (July) and in November (2025-11-20 dividend +1 yen and cancellation), not at Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Returns items are what this stock buys: +4.7% on 2026-07-14 (DOE / buyback / MTP) and a late-session rise on 2025-11-20 (dividend +1 yen and cancellation of 10.67% of shares).
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing to price. This finding records that the one line this stock has rallied on is unlikely to be in this release, which removes upside tail rather than adding a sign.
findings.independence: DOE timing in a separate notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260714592884.pdf: '2027年11月期の配当より適用').

outside_window.finding: Year-end upward revision or extra dividend in late November. The company did this on 2023-11-17, 2024-11-19 and 2025-11-20 (kabutan revision history) if it holds the plan at Q3.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: the main item. Plan OrdP 3,700m against consensus 3,975m; Q3 revision record 2 of 5 (2021, 2023); about 45% this time. Returns: unlikely; DOE applies from FY2027 and the buyback is already running. New-year guide: not at Q3; it comes in January. Quarter vs its own 進捗率: Q3 cumulative likely ~84-86% of plan against 80.1% at Q3 FY2025 and a ~67-72% five-year Q3 average, a visibly high progress rate that the stock has not rewarded on past quarter-only prints.

baseline_tension: Roughly agrees with the baseline. The positioning lean (-0.875, margin overhang) and this name's habit of selling quarter-only prints both point mildly down. The strongest positive the release could carry, an upward FY revision toward the 3,975m consensus, is genuinely possible given record-high Q3 progress and was searched for. Netted, they leave nothing the price clearly lacks.
lessons_applied: Rule 1: the reported-quarter negative rests on public data (acquisition dates in the 短信, public weather records), so its size went from -0.3 to -0.2 and p_up moved from 48 to 49.
Rule 2: wrote the strongest positive (an FY revision toward consensus) into baseline_tension; it was already searched for and sized in the guidance finding, so no further change.
The guidance and capital_return findings were left as they were.
